Description.value: Client-side companion to the PackRelay launcher. When the launcher writes a `packrelay-quickjoin.json` sentinel into the userdatafolder before spawning 7DTD, this mod picks it up when the main menu opens and joins that server through the game's own Direct Connect dialog, so Connect in the launcher lands you in the server. Needs 7DTD 3.x for the auto-join; on older versions it logs the address instead. Harmless on dedicated servers (the main menu never opens there).
